# canary order --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary order — Preview, place, change, cancel or check orders

Usage: canary order <action> [flags]

Actions
  preview           Check an order without submitting it
  status            Read one order from the local journal
  place             Submit an eligible preview through the trading gates
  modify            Replace an order using an eligible preview
  cancel            Request an order cancellation through the trading gates

Run canary order <action> --help for syntax and flags.

\x1b[1mcanary order — Preview, place, change, cancel or check orders\x1b[0m

Usage: \x1b[36mcanary order <action> [flags]\x1b[0m

\x1b[1mActions\x1b[0m

  \x1b[36mstatus            \x1b[0mRead one order from the local journal
  \x1b[36mplace             \x1b[0mSubmit an eligible preview through the trading gates
  \x1b[36mmodify            \x1b[0mReplace an order using an eligible preview
  \x1b[36mcancel            \x1b[0mRequest an order cancellation through the trading gates

Run canary order <action> --help for syntax and flags.
